edits.old: The contract serves SCR-04 Case timeline in its Loading, Filtered and Empty states and the queue-history tab on the same screen, and it supplies the timeline section of SCR-03 Case record. All of them are served by the gateway-bff composite route (DP-19), owned by RWB-PLT-N001-CON, which calls rwb-case and the other owners in parallel and merges the answers; the document fixes the case side of that merge and no screen field list.
edits.new: The contract serves SCR-04 Case timeline in its Loading and Filtered states and the queue-history tab on the same screen, and it supplies the timeline section of SCR-03 Case record in its Loading state. The Empty, Error and No access states of SCR-03 and SCR-04 are Not specified in the source documents (CG-ALL-4258, CG-ALL-4259). All of them are served by the gateway-bff composite route (DP-19), owned by RWB-PLT-N001-CON, which calls rwb-case and the other owners in parallel and merges the answers; the document fixes the case side of that merge and no screen field list.
